layer: MMS cross-check: current (primary) vs GLEAM 3.0 South Asia
crosscheck_source: GLEAM 3.0 South Asia (data/gleam_mms.csv; FAO GLEAM Ref Doc v1.0 T3.2-3.5)
dairy_split_crosscheck: dairy_cattle_share=0.295 kept (FAOSTAT milk-animals/stock). GLEAM 3.0 publishes no comparable in-milk fraction -- it derives herd structure endogenously (SA fertility 75%%, replacement 21%%, calving 3.1yr) -- so the FAOSTAT value is retained as primary; enteric (151.5 Mt) unchanged.
finding: GLEAM's dry-lot-heavy South-Asia split (56% cattle dry lot, EF3=0.02) raises manure direct N2O 2.6x (23.2->60.9 Gg) and the manure category to 32.1 Mt vs FAOSTAT 14.6. This is a GLEAM-MMS-vs-IPCC-EF3 taxonomy mismatch, not a refinement: the current FAOSTAT-consistent split stays primary; GLEAM surfaces MMS as a large hidden uncertainty. No control total changes.
